title: nepeta rotundifolia
intro: Nepeta rotundifolia, commonly known as Roundleaf Catmint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, and is used to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta rotundifolia are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils such as nepetalactone, which is responsible for its calming effects, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant properties.
